risks.quote: There can be mistakes in the transcriptions though, so these must be checked carefully for accuracy.
Concerns have been expressed about the level of data extraction demanded by these tools, with this possibly conflicting with data protection requirements.

responsibilities.quote: AI is a machine operated by algorithms. Its outputs must always be treated critically.
Use such tools cautiously and only ever with explicit ethics committee approval.
Being responsible for complying with regulatory, legal, and professional obligations
